title: Trace what one lost packet delays
description: Choose a protocol and workload, then change concurrency, round-trip time, and loss events. The trace isolates request admission from transport head-of-line blocking; it is an explanatory model, not a network benchmark.

profiles.label: API fan-out
profiles.detail: Eight independent responses, with one request carrying the simulated loss.

profiles.label: Application shell
profiles.detail: Eighteen HTML, CSS, JavaScript, font, image, and API responses compete for the same origin.

profiles.label: Media grid
profiles.detail: Thirty-two independent objects expose connection limits and queued admission waves.

protocols.label: HTTP/1.1 pool
protocols.detail: One active response per TCP connection in this model, with at most six origin connections.

protocols.label: HTTP/2
protocols.detail: Frames from concurrent streams share one ordered TCP byte stream.

protocols.label: HTTP/3
protocols.detail: Request streams use QUIC loss recovery independently, while congestion control remains connection-wide.
